itinerary.notes:
A whimsical, one-of-a-kind farm, art studio/shop

The Gourd Garden: 
 - Visitors can walk through lush viney trellises to see how gourds grow and learn about the cultivation and drying process.

The Gallery and Shop: 
 - A collection of finished, hand-crafted organic art pieces is available for purchase, including intricate nightlights, vases, and sculptures.

Workshops and Crafting:
 - Guests of all ages can try their hand at making their own personalized gourd art using simple carving and decorating tools.

ideas.name: Taughannock Falls State Park
ideas.blurb: 215ft plunge, taller than Niagara. Flat 0.75mi gorge trail to the base.

ideas.name: Robert H. Treman State Park
ideas.blurb: Swim at the base of Lower Falls. Gorge trail passes 12 waterfalls.

ideas.name: Watkins Glen State Park
ideas.blurb: 19 waterfalls in 2 miles of stone stairs and tunnels. The famous one.

ideas.name: Cascadilla Gorge Trail
ideas.blurb: Six waterfalls climbing from downtown Ithaca up to Cornell. Short and steep.

ideas.name: Ithaca Farmers Market
ideas.blurb: Waterfront pavilion at Steamboat Landing. Sat 9-3, Sun 10-3. Food stalls, not just produce.

ideas.name: Cornell Botanic Gardens
ideas.blurb: Free. Herb garden, arboretum, and the Slim Jim Woods trails.

ideas.name: Stewart Park
ideas.blurb: Cayuga Lake shoreline, carousel, big shade trees. Easy with no plan.

ideas.name: Lime Hollow Nature Center
ideas.blurb: Boardwalks, bog, treehouse. Closest real nature to the Airbnb.

ideas.name: Greek Peak Mountain Coaster
ideas.blurb: Alpine coaster you control. Also a zipline and adventure center.

ideas.name: Cayuga Lake Wine Trail
ideas.blurb: Tasting rooms up both shores. Sheldrake Point and Six Mile Creek are the easy picks.

ideas.name: Buttermilk Falls State Park
ideas.blurb: Swimming hole at the base plus the gorge climb. Already on the itinerary Friday.

ideas.name: Cornell Lab of Ornithology
ideas.blurb: Free. Bird cams, sound library, 4 miles of Sapsucker Woods trail outside.

ideas.name: Museum of the Earth
ideas.blurb: Full mastodon and a right whale skeleton. Good rain plan, about 2 hours.

ideas.name: Herbert F. Johnson Museum of Art
ideas.blurb: Free. I.M. Pei building, and the 5th floor has the best view of Cayuga Lake.

ideas.name: Sciencenter
ideas.blurb: Hands-on science museum. Built for kids but the outdoor mini golf is fun regardless.

ideas.name: Center Ithaca / Ithaca Commons
ideas.blurb: Food court with the soup dumplings, plus the pedestrian mall shops.

ideas.name: Cortland Beer Company
ideas.blurb: Small taproom downtown Cortland. Closest good beer to the Airbnb.

ideas.name: Purity Ice Cream
ideas.blurb: Ithaca institution since 1936. The other dairy option if the Cornell line is long.

ideas.name: 1890 House Museum
ideas.blurb: Chateau-style mansion with a tower you can climb. Right in Cortland.

ideas.name: Cortland Repertory Theatre
ideas.blurb: Summer stock at the Pavilion in Little York Lake. Check what is running.
